notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM-composition rule: object attributes and interaction parameters may name only simple, enumerated, reference, array, fixed-record, or variant-record data types (or NA). The generic composed-model resolver recognizes basic-data names from the complete schema key so table-specific predicates can report the applicable category error, while these two application-table columns reject a raw basic-data name. The predefined HLAtoken remains accepted without an Umbra-specific name exception because the official MIM declares it as array data. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
